layer4-verification-deepcode.description: DeepCode In-Flight Verification: Real-time AST syntax, zero ghost packages, and zero-raw-LaTeX validation before commits.

layer5-continual-evolution.description: Continual Self-Evolution & Staging Barrier: Trajectory failure signature tracking with empirical recurrence threshold (count >= 2) and staged patch operator verification.

layer6-memory-vault.description: Hermes Agent Memory Vault: PreInvocation recall and PostInvocation attestation persistence in SQLite.

token-budget-tracker.description: Tracks session token consumption, model routing, and context saturation ceilings.
